NOTICE IS HEREBY ORDERED by the Mayor/Chairman that a special meeting of the City Council/Housing
Authority will be held on Tuesday, December 8, 2020, at 2:05 P.M., in the Council Chambers, One Manchester
Boulevard, Inglewood, California (Government Code Section 54956)

*****NOTE FROM THE CITY: PUBLIC PARTICIPATION: Due to the existing COVID-19 health emergency and the
social distancing measures currently in effect, and pursuant to the Governor’s Executive Order N-29-20
(https://www.gov.ca.gov/wp -content/uploads/2020/03/3.17.20 -N-29-20-EO.pdf), please note that members of the
public will be allowed to observe and/or address the City Council Meeting of December 8, 2020, at 2:05 P.M.
as follows:

  1.  Written Public Comments: Members of the public may choose to submit comments electronically for
  consideration by the Inglewood City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority/Joint Powers
  Authority (Legislative Body) by sending them to the City Clerk/Secretary at
  yhorton@cityofinglewood.org, a n d D e p u t y C i t y C l e r k aphillips@cityofinglewood.org. To ensure
  distribution to the members of the Legislative Body prior to consideration of the agenda, please
  submit comments prior to 8:00 A.M. the day of the meeting, and in the body of the email, please
  identify the agenda number or subject matter. Correspondence should indicate the meeting date and
  agenda item. Comments received after 8:00 A.M. and prior to the close of the public hearings, will be
  made part of the official public record of the meeting. Contact the Office of the City Clerk at 310 -412-
  5280 with any questions.

  2.  By Telephone -Listening to the Meeting and Making Oral Public Comments: Members of the public
  can participate in the meeting by telephone to listen and make comments noting the following:

  l The conference begins at 1:30 p.m., Pacific Time, and all interested parties may join the conference 5

minutes_text:
Inglewood, California
  December 8, 2020

  The City Council of the City of Inglewood, California held a special meeting on
  Wednesday, December 8, 2020, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.
  Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called the
  City Council into joint session with the Housing Authority at the hour of 2:53 p.m.
  The City Clerk/Housing Authority Secretary announced the presence of a quorum as
  follows:

  Present:  Mayor/ Housing Authority Chairman Butts, Council
  Members/Housing Authority Members Dotson, Padilla,
  Morales and Franklin; and
  Absent:  None.
  City/Housing Authority officials and personnel present were as follows:
  Yvonne Horton  City Clerk/Secretary*
  Artie Fields  City Manager/Executive Director*
  Ken Campos  City Attorney/General Counsel*
  David Esparza  Asst. City Manager/CFO
  Jacquelyn Gordon  Staff Assistant

  * Serves as indicated for the Housing Authority.

  PUBLIC COMMENTS – AGENDA ITEMS.  Mayor Butts/Housing Authority
  Chairman inquired if there were any persons present who wished to address the City
  Council/Housing Authority on any item on this matter.

  Gil Mathieu, District 4, spoke regarding the difficulties he’s experiencing while logging
  into the City Council Meetings.

  Caller (Name Unknown) gave thanks to the City Council for allowing the City of Los
  Angeles into their office. She spoke regarding Proposition 22, and wanted the outcome of
  the special meeting that’s being held.

  Caller (Name Unknown) asked for clarity about Agenda Item No. H-2, adoption of a
  resolution approving the Second Amendment to the DDA.

131.8  RESOLUTION NO. 21-39 ADOPTED – APPROVING THE SECOND
  AMENDMENT TO THE DISPOSITION AND DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT
  (DDA), AND AUTHORIZING THE MAYOR TO EXECUTE AND IMPLEMENT
  THE AGREEMENT.  Staff report dated December 8, 2020, was presented
  recommending approval of the Second Amendment to the Disposition and Development
  Agreement by and among the City of Inglewood, Inglewood Housing Authority, as
  housing successor to the former Inglewood Redevelopment Agency (“Authority”), and
  Beach Avenue Housing, L.P., a California limited partnership (“Developer”) providing
  for certain changes to that certain Disposition and Development Agreement dated March
  4,2020, ( the “DDA”), as amended by the First Amendment to Disposition and
  Development Agreement dated August 25, 2020, (the “First Amendment”) (collectively,
  the “DDA” and “First Amendment” are referred to herein as the “Agreement”) relating to
  additional project costs and financing, certain Housing and Urban Development (HUD)
  requirements contained in riders to be incorporated into the DDA and its attachments as
  set forth in the Second Amendment, and a density bonus covenant, with respect to the
  development of a 42-unit affordable housing rental project (the “Project”) located at 716
  through 730 West Beach Avenue, Inglewood, CA 90301.

  It was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by Council Member Franklin
  that the City Council does hereby: 1) Adopt Resolution No. 21-39 entitled:
   RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  APPROVING THE SECOND AMENDMENT TO THE DISPOSITION AND
  DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT BY AND AMONG THE CITY OF
  INGLEWOOD, INGLEWOOD HOUSING AUTHORITY, AND BEACH
  AVENUE HOUSING, LP FOR THE AFFORDABLE HOUSING PROJECT
  LOCATED AT 716-730 W. BEACH AVENUE.

and; 2) Authorize the Mayor and Council Members to advance the Authority up to
$3,500,000 from Account Code No. 001.10030 that will be reimbursed to the City by the
Redevelopment Housing Bond funds upon approval of funding from the Department of
Finance; and 3) Authorize the Mayor to execute the agreement and to implement the
Agreement, as amended by the proposed Second Amendment, and the related and
required subordination agreements in the form attached hereto. The motion was carried
by the following roll call vote:
Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin, and Mayor Butts; and
Noes: None.

There being no further business to be presented, Mayor Butts declared the meeting
adjourned at the hour of 3:04 p.m.

Approved this 22nd day of June, 2021.

  ______________________________
  Aisha L. Thompson, City Clerk

___________________________
  James Butts, Jr., Mayor
